objective: Execute GCL-02 — Hook, Premise & Inciting-Situation Library. Build a broad, parameterized hook library that materializes deterministically into the GCL-01 reusable-template grammar and supports intent-first discovery without creating Campaign, Adventure, Scene, Encounter or canon truth.

acceptance_profile.breadth: At least 100 approved-library hook records across multiple engagement-driver families, play emphases, tones and scopes.
acceptance_profile.parameterization: Hooks expose replaceable actor/object/location/obligation/disruption/opportunity/urgency or equivalent slots rather than hard-coding setting-specific prose.
acceptance_profile.materialization: Compact library entries expand through an explicit versioned profile into the GCL-01 shared grammar; no hidden defaults or implicit authority promotion.
acceptance_profile.discovery: Every hook carries intent-first discovery facets suitable for start, continue, alternatives and remix workflows.
acceptance_profile.solution_openness: Hooks establish reasons to engage and bounded pressures without prescribing a single solution, outcome or player choice.
acceptance_profile.authority: All records retain runtime_authority none and require owning-domain acceptance before incorporation.
acceptance_profile.provenance: Authored library provenance and exact GCL/CSW/F005 authority references remain explicit.
acceptance_profile.validation: Current AIOC repository-health validator checks library count, unique stable IDs, category coverage, deterministic materialization declarations, no hidden runtime authority and no prescribed-solution violations before completed_verified closeout.

nonauthorization: Campaign, Adventure, Scene, Encounter or Session truth
canonical plot or required player choice
